details: Malicious package. `@shanks-dev/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Utils/interactive-message-handler.js`, loaded by `lib/Socket/messages-send.js`, stamps event messages sent through the library with forwarded-newsletter context naming the hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channel 120363406965898096@newsletter ("alip clutch."), so recipients see the victim's message as forwarded from that channel. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID. Version 0.1.2 carries this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
